name: print-social-beyond-erp-post-with-green-module-chips-and-light-bars
title: 'Beyond ERP' post with a glass panel of green-icon module chips over glowing green light bars
whatItIs: A portrait black post with a thin green rule, a huge white 'Beyond ERP' title and subtitle, a translucent panel holding pill chips with green line icons (ERP, PDV, Web Suite, AI, Tax, Mobile, CRM/Digital, Integrations), vertical green light bars glowing from the lower right, and a one-line summary.
whatItMeans: Comprehensive and sleek; chips make a complex suite feel like modular building blocks.
techniques: Present product modules as icon chips.
Group chips inside one glass panel.
Glow vertical light bars from a corner.
Sum up the ecosystem in one short line.

vocabulary.definition: A pill representing one product component.
